rootPassive.name: Grounded
rootPassive.text: Immune to lightning stuns, including from enemy storms. Storm strikes deal you half damage, and the storm picks you last.

trunk.name: Spark
trunk.text: Basic lightning spell: a fast bolt that shocks

trunk.name: Shock chance
trunk.text: Weapon hits have a chance to add a free burst of shock

trunk.name: Static strike
trunk.text: Basic lightning weapon art: a thrust that arcs to one more enemy

nodes.name: Chain lightning
nodes.text: Spell: lightning that jumps from enemy to enemy

nodes.name: Arc
nodes.text: One more jump for Chain lightning and Static strike's arc

nodes.name: Conductive
nodes.text: Soaked enemies take more lightning damage

nodes.name: Thunderclap
nodes.text: Spell: a thunderous burst around you that shocks and staggers

nodes.name: Overcharge
nodes.text: More lightning damage while your Charge is nearly full

nodes.name: Tempest
nodes.text: a storm around you that strikes your enemies

nodes.name: Bolt dash
nodes.text: Dash as lightning through enemies, shocking each one you pass

nodes.name: Afterimage
nodes.text: A dodge leaves a spark where it started that bursts a moment later

nodes.name: Rapid fire
nodes.text: At high Charge you attack faster and your spells come back sooner

nodes.name: Lightning step
nodes.text: bolt dash up to three times in quick succession

nodes.name: Charged weapon
nodes.text: Weapon art: release all your Charge in one overhead blow; hold to store more

nodes.name: Static field
nodes.text: Spell: a field of static on the ground that shocks what stands in it

nodes.name: Discharge
nodes.text: Blocking a hit releases a shock around you; a parry doubles it

nodes.name: Thunder god
nodes.text: for a while every weapon hit calls down a bolt on the target
